ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In 'The Barber's New Blade', why does the barber use a new blade for each customer? (1 mark)
   A. New blades are cheaper
   B. The blade is red
   C. Customers like blades
   D. Sharing blades can pass germs through blood

2. 'I saw a goat. ___ goat was brown.' Which article fits the blank? (1 mark)
   A. The
   B. Some
   C. An
   D. A

3. Which is a positive statement? (1 mark)
   A. The shed is not locked.
   B. The shed is locked.
   C. The shed was never locked.
   D. The shed isn't locked.

4. What should a person with diarrhoea do? (1 mark)
   A. Stop drinking water
   B. Drink plenty of safe water and see a health worker
   C. Share their cup
   D. Stay away from clean water

5. According to the text, when should we wash our hands? (1 mark)
   A. Only when we see dirt
   B. After using the toilet
   C. Only on Sundays
   D. Never with soap

6. Which is NOT a good way to run a reading club? (1 mark)
   A. Meet at a regular time
   B. Keep a list of books read
   C. Everyone talks at once
   D. Take turns to speak

7. When is it fair to interrupt a speaker? (1 mark)
   A. When you disagree loudly
   B. When you did not hear or someone needs urgent help
   C. When you are bored
   D. When you want to talk instead

8. What is a clinic? (1 mark)
   A. A market stall
   B. A place where people get health care
   C. A place for playing football
   D. A school library

9. What is a topic sentence? (1 mark)
   A. A sentence that tells what the paragraph is about
   B. The last word of the paragraph
   C. A list of adjectives
   D. A question at the end

10. Which is a good way to learn a hard spelling? (1 mark)
   A. Never write it
   B. Look, cover, write and check
   C. Guess it every time
   D. Copy it wrongly

11. What should you do if a question does not apply to you? (1 mark)
   A. Write a false answer
   B. Write N/A or draw a line
   C. Leave it empty
   D. Tear the form

12. At the end of a yes or no question, the voice usually (1 mark)
   A. stops
   B. stays low always
   C. rises
   D. falls

13. 'A lot of' can be used with (1 mark)
   A. only plural nouns
   B. only names
   C. only verbs
   D. both countable and uncountable nouns

14. What is the answer to this riddle? 'I am used to wash the body. I make bubbles and get smaller each time you use me.' (1 mark)
   A. a broom
   B. soap
   C. a bucket
   D. a towel

15. Which is a good listening habit? (1 mark)
   A. Shout answers before the question ends
   B. Talk to your neighbour
   C. Look out of the window
   D. Look at the speaker

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Correct these sentences: (a) 'I have money enough to buy bread.' (b) 'She has alot of friends.' (2 marks)

17. Explain what 'prevention' means and use it in a sentence. (3 marks)

18. Use the words 'sibling', 'relative' and 'chore' in three sentences about a family. (3 marks)

19. Write two ways you can show a speaker that you are listening actively. (2 marks)

20. Explain what word stress is. Give one example. (2 marks)

21. Name the seven coordinating conjunctions. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Sharing blades can pass germs through blood
   He explains that blood can carry germs.

2. A — The
   The goat has already been mentioned, so we use the.

3. B — The shed is locked.
   It has no negative word.

4. B — Drink plenty of safe water and see a health worker
   Drinking safe water and seeking help is important.

5. B — After using the toilet
   The text lists after using the toilet, before eating and more.

6. C — Everyone talks at once
   A club needs turn-taking so everyone is heard.

7. B — When you did not hear or someone needs urgent help
   Only interrupt for good reasons, and do so politely.

8. B — A place where people get health care
   Clinics give health care.

9. A — A sentence that tells what the paragraph is about
   It states the main idea.

10. B — Look, cover, write and check
   Cover-write-check builds memory.

11. B — Write N/A or draw a line
   N/A means not applicable and shows that you did not forget.

12. C — rises
   Yes or no questions usually end with a rise.

13. D — both countable and uncountable nouns
   For example a lot of books and a lot of rain.

14. B — soap
   Soap makes bubbles and wears away.

15. D — Look at the speaker
   Looking at the speaker shows you are listening.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: (a) I have enough money to buy bread. (b) She has a lot of friends.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Prevention means acting so that something bad does not happen. For example: Washing hands is a way of prevention.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for the meaning, 1 for a sentence.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: My sibling is my little sister. My aunt is a relative. My chore is to sweep the yard.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Look at the speaker and nod; keep still and quiet; say 'I see'.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Word stress is the syllable we say more strongly in a word, for example the first syllable in HOS-pi-tal.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for the example.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for all seven, 2 for five or six, 1 for three or four.
